verdict.rationale: Beamer's changelog docs say posts can include images and videos and can be drafted with AI. That is glancing evidence of rich formatting for changelog content, but no rich text editor is actually described. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented rich text editor, custom/reusable components, support for help-center content, any detail on formatting options, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can use a rich text editor with custom components to format changelog and help content

citations.quote: Use visuals like images and videos to further increase user engagement.
Create clear, on-brand changelog posts in seconds with AI.
